test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_signal_decay.py tests/test_phase5_half_life.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/evaluation/signal_decay.py tests/test_signal_decay.py

implemented: Computes peak information horizon and interpolated half-life for every registered family.
Reports net alpha, turnover, and turnover-to-absolute-net-alpha by horizon with explicit undefined status near zero alpha.
Requires a matched decision/session schedule across every horizon and rejects access to protected final-window dates.
Retains the observation rows and hash; never changes an existing decision horizon.
blockers: Observations and development dataset digest are caller-supplied, not resolved from an authoritative registry.
Horizon change is not connected to an independently verified preregistered new strategy version.
No real forward-market decay cohort is included; test data is synthetic.
